name: Depth of field — rack-focus title reveal
description: Dynamic multiplane depth-of-field (ADR-0027). Opens on the big type-hero word 'HIVIZ' sharp on the focal plane while the lower-third title card sits behind it, soft. Over the first half-second the focus RACKS (animated focusPull 0.0 → 0.7, smoothstep) from the Surface plane to the Overlay plane: the brand word melts into bright luminous bokeh and the 'Depth of Field' title card resolves into tack-sharp focus. The blur is depth-driven (the rack moves the focal plane between layers, not a screen band) and the focus animates frame-deterministically off the timeline. A title card over a bokeh background with a real, moving rack focus — the cinematic move.
